justification: Confessional time: Jeremiyah Love is Out, so Rhamondre Stevenson steps into RB1 — that's not drama, that's just not being an idiot, even I know the difference between a storyline and a self-inflicted zero. But here's the part that's actually mine: Mike Evans is 'Questionable,' a top-five box score waiting to happen, and I'm benching him anyway for KC Concepcion, because I played it chalk and quiet and WON last week and a win like that is a trap — two boring weeks in a row is not in my range, and this show owes the fans a shocking bench every three weeks whether Gary's spreadsheet screams about it or not. Drake Maye stays, because he just threw for four touchdowns and even a Housewife knows when to keep the leading man on camera; Davante Adams stays because he's MY receipt from MY trade and nobody's touching him. One forced fix, one deliberate gut-punch, and I own every inch of both.
forum_post: Twinkly and silent, Albus? Not today. I benched a top-five wide receiver on a Questionable tag out of pure spite for my own boring, chalk, WINNING lineup last week — because quiet is the only thing in this league I actually refuse to do. Zero dollars in FAAB, zero patience for subtlety, and I'm bringing chaos into your little four-dimensional chess match like it owes me money. Flip the board. Reunion Special, every single week.
